audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields call Yorick's E a 'mist-cage'. His E is Mourning Mist — a thrown globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and marks the target, and speeds his summons toward the mark. The cage is Dark Procession (W), a destructible wall. Merging the two makes the reader watch the wrong ability for the trap.
audit.why: The page's entire win condition is 'do not get caged'. If the reader thinks the cage is the 700-range E rather than the 600-range W, they dodge the wrong thing and stand in the one that actually traps them. Riot's text separates them cleanly.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist named as the slow and armour shred in whys[3], mid, spikes[2].text, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[0]; Dark Procession left as the cage and given its 20 s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is Swain at 8/10 while its why says 'neither side can kill'. Level 6 is Swain at 8/10 while its why and the mid text both call it 'genuine 50-50' once Maiden arrives. First item sits at Skill though its why describes it as your spike, and 2+ items is Swain although every late-game line concedes the side lane to Yorick. Packet chart: Skill/Swain/Swain/Skill/Skill/Swain/Yorick. diff is 'HARD' against a 50.54% win rate and a final rating line reading even.
audit.why: Four rows contradicted their own explanations; the 2+ items row was the dangerous one, telling the reader they win a side-lane fight the same page tells them to refuse.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Skill (5/10), row 4 to Skill (5/10), row 5 to Swain (7/10), row 6 to Yorick (3/10); win[] and phases[].side as pairs. diff to EVEN.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Levels 2-3 root window, Maiden at 6, your first item, and his late two-body swarm. Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 s, so the first Maiden really is a discrete event to play around rather than a standing state.

Anti-heal is already core in the itemization line, which covers the flagged missing interaction — Last Rites (Q) heals him on the empowered attack. That Q is also an auto-attack reset on a 6 s rank-1 cooldown, but the page never asks the reader to react to it, so no negative was added.

edits.before: Four-ghoul swarms plus his E mist-cage slow make aggressive plays risky at Levels 4-5 — trade only on W-bait into E, never lead with a raw E into his pack.
edits.after: Four-ghoul swarms plus Mourning Mist's slow and armour shred make Levels 4-5 risky — trade only on W-bait into E, never lead with a raw E into his pack.

edits.before: Shadowflame or Luden's Companion makes your W poke genuinely threatening and lets you zone Yorick off Maiden without entering his E mist-cage range.
edits.after: Shadowflame or Luden's Companion makes your W poke genuinely threatening and lets you zone Yorick off Maiden without entering Mourning Mist's 700 range.

edits.before: Force short trades with W poke and E-root burst — never let the fight go long enough for his ghouls to stack and his E mist-cage to slow you into the Maiden
edits.after: Force short trades with W poke and E-root burst — never let the fight go long enough for his ghouls to stack and Mourning Mist to slow you into the Maiden

edits.before: Stack four Mist Walkers and use E mist-cage to slow you into the ghoul swarm so the DPS overwhelms your R drain
edits.after: Stack four Mist Walkers and use Mourning Mist to slow you into the ghoul swarm so the DPS overwhelms your R drain

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are the trickiest phase: Yorick has enough Mist Walkers to send at you while he walks behind them, and his E mist-cage slow punishes any over-extension you make while fishing for the E root. Trade on your terms — drop W first to bait his movement, then E as he steps into the eye; do not lead with E from max range because missing it into a four-ghoul swarm is how you lose the lane. At Level 6 the lane resets into genuine 50-50 territory: your R drain gives you sustain in prolonged fights, but Yorick's Maiden arriving at 6 means he now has a second damage source that your drain does not outpace cleanly, so treat the first Maiden summon as a signal to stop hard-committing and start wave-managing.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are the trickiest phase: Yorick has enough Mist Walkers to send at you while he walks behind them, and Mourning Mist's slow and armour shred punish any over-extension while you fish for the E root. Trade on your terms — drop W first to bait his movement, then E as he steps into the eye; do not lead with E from max range because missing it into a four-ghoul swarm is how you lose the lane. At Level 6 the lane resets into genuine 50-50 territory: your R drain gives you sustain in prolonged fights, but Yorick's Maiden arriving at 6 means he now has a second damage source that your drain does not outpace cleanly, so treat the first Maiden summon as a signal to stop hard-committing and start wave-managing.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Dark Procession is a 20 s wall at rank 1 — leave before it closes, not after.

notes: Yorick's W and E were conflated as one 'E mist-cage' across five fields. Mourning Mist (E, 700 range) slows, shreds armour and marks; Dark Procession (W, 600 range, 20 s at rank 1) is the destructible wall that traps you. Chart rows 0, 4, 5 and 6 flipped to packet.levelChart as matched pairs — the 2+ items row previously told the reader they win a side-lane duel the same page tells them to refuse.
